meta.name: Constant approximation · ℓp norms
meta.regime: For every ε > 0 and fixed p ∈ [1,∞], some constant γ(p,ε) approximates full-rank CVP_p
meta.rules: For each fixed ε > 0 and fixed p ∈ [1,∞], find a γ(p,ε)-approximate closest lattice vector on full-rank lattices L ⊂ R^n. Compare c only under these quantifiers. Include preprocessing. Do not interpret the bound as exact CVP, fixed 1.97-CVP, or a fixed approximation constant uniform in ε.
